008package paint.shared.validate;
009import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
010import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
011
012import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
013import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser;
014import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVRecord;
015
016import java.io.File;
017import java.io.IOException;
018import java.io.Reader;
019import java.util.*;
020
021/**
022 * Performs cross-row consistency checks for condition metadata in PAINT experiment CSVs.
023 * <p>
024 * Ensures that all rows with the same CONDITION_NUMBER share identical values for
025 * critical attributes (probe, cell type, adjuvant, concentration, etc.).
026 * </p>
027 * The function can be called ob Experiment Info amd Recordings CSVs.
028 */
029public final class ConditionConsistencyChecker {
030
031    /**
032     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
033     */
034    private ConditionConsistencyChecker() {
035    }
036
037    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
038    // MAIN VALIDATION METHOD
039    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
040
041    /**
042     * Validates the specified CSV file for consistency among rows sharing the same
043     * {@code Condition Number}.
044     * <p>
045     * For each unique condition number, all attribute columns are compared.
046     * Any inconsistency between rows is reported
047     * as an error. Duplicate errors are suppressed to reduce log noise.
048     * </p>
049     *
050     * @param file           the experiment CSV file to validate
051     * @return {@link ValidationResult} containing all consistency check results
052     */
053    public static ValidationResult check(File file) {
054        ValidationResult result     = new ValidationResult();
055        Set<String>      seenErrors = new HashSet<>(); // <-- prevent duplicates
056
057        // Cannot use a standard reading method, because this one covers two different formats
058        try (Reader reader = TextFiles.newReader(file.toPath());
059             CSVParser  parser = CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
060                     .setHeader()
061                     .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
062                     .build()
063                     .parse(reader)) {
064
065            /*
066             * A condition group looks like this:
067             *  Condition 3:
068             *      ProbeName     = 2 Tri
069             *      ProbeType     = Simple
070             *      CellType      = CHO-MR
071             *      Adjuvant      = LPS
072             *      Concentration = 5.0
073             * All entries with condition 3 need to have the same values for all attributes
074             */
075
076            Map<String, Map<String, String>> conditionGroups = new HashMap<>();
077
078            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
079                String condition      = record.get(CONDITION_NUMBER);
080                String probeName      = record.get(PROBE_NAME);
081                String probeType      = record.get(PROBE_TYPE);
082                String cellType       = record.get(CELL_TYPE);
083                String adjuvant       = record.get(ADJUVANT);
084                String concentration  = record.get(CONCENTRATION);
085
086                Map<String, String> currentAttributes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
087                currentAttributes.put(PROBE_NAME,    probeName);
088                currentAttributes.put(PROBE_TYPE,    probeType);
089                currentAttributes.put(CELL_TYPE,     cellType);
090                currentAttributes.put(ADJUVANT,      adjuvant);
091                currentAttributes.put(CONCENTRATION, concentration);
092
093                if (!conditionGroups.containsKey(condition)) {   // First occurrence of condition — record as baseline
094                    conditionGroups.put(condition, currentAttributes);
095                } else {                                         // Compare against existing baseline
096                    Map<String, String> baseline = conditionGroups.get(condition);
097                    for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : currentAttributes.entrySet()) {
098                        String col      = entry.getKey();
099                        String value    = entry.getValue();
100                        String expected = baseline.get(col);
101
102                        if (!Objects.equals(expected, value)) {
103                            String msg = "Condition " + condition
104                                    + " - Inconsistent '" + col + "': "
105                                    + expected + " / " + value;
106
107                            // Prevent duplicate messages
108                            if (seenErrors.add(msg)) {
109                                result.addError(msg);
110                            }
111                        }
112                    }
113                }
114            }
115        } catch (IOException e) {
116            result.addError("Error reading file during consistency check: " + e.getMessage());
117        }
118        return result;
119    }
120}
